h:
v0.02 - 添加了可选的提示增强器 - 基于 LatentHearts 的 LTX2.3 All In One 工作流程。

LatentHearts 的 LTX2.3 All in One 工作流程中的提示增强器非常有用，因此将其稍作修改后纳入其中。根据您的需要启用/禁用。

v0.01 - 初始

使用最少量的自定义节点从文本或图像制作 LTX 视频的工作流程。我选择了尽可能基本的设置。左侧视频是一名女子在城市中行走的文本转视频，右侧视频是一名女子在海滩上行走的图像转视频。

这些工作流程基于 LatentHeart 的 LTX2.3 All in One Legacy 工作流程，并且几乎被分解到最低限度。我包含了使用 LTX Director 的工作流程和不使用 LTX Director 的工作流程。

o.en:
v0.02 - Added an optional prompt enhancer - based on LatentHearts's LTX2.3 All In One workflow.

The prompt enhancer that was in LatentHearts's LTX2.3 All in One workflow was very useful so incorporated it in with a slight modification. Enable/Disable as you see fit.

v0.01 - Initial

Workflows to do LTX Video from either text or image utilizing the least amount of custom nodes. I went for as basic of a setup as you can get. The left video of the woman walking in the city is text to video and the right video is a woman on the beach walking is image to video.

These workflows were based on LatentHeart's LTX2.3 All in One Legacy workflow and broken down to almost the bare minimum. I've included a workflow with the LTX Director and one without.
